We chose five vertebrate, five invertebrate, and five plant taxa.

The trophic position resolution was fine in some taxa (fishes, (Froese and Pauly, 2022)), while for others it was an ordered factor consisting of two or three levels (herbivores, omnivores, or carnivores).
